title: Herbaceous Kenyan Vegetable Skillet
description: A light and crunchy Kenyan dish featuring a blend of herbaceous vegetables and a hint of apple cider vinegar, cooked to perfection in a donabe vessel.
instructions: Preheat the donabe vessel over medium heat.
Add the olive oil and saute the diced sweet potatoes until they are slightly tender.
Add the grated carrots and cook for an additional 3 minutes.
Add the trimmed green beans and cook until they are tender but still crisp.
In a small bowl, whisk together the apple cider vinegar, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the vinegar mixture over the vegetables and stir to combine.
In a separate bowl, mix the sodium alginate with the water to create a spherification bath.
Using a syringe or spoon, drop small amounts of the vegetable mixture into the spherification bath to create bite-sized spheres.
Let the spheres sit in the bath for 2-3 minutes to set.
Remove the spheres from the bath with a slotted spoon and serve immediately.
